sv.title: Lokala centerpartister splittrade om högersväng: ”Kört fast”
sv.summary: Centerpartiet återupptar samtalen med högersidan, meddelade partiledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist i går, men bland partiets lokala företrädare råder delade meningar.

en.title: Local Centre Party members split over right-wing turn: “Stuck”
en.summary: The Centre Party is resuming talks with the right, party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist announced yesterday, but opinions among the party's local representatives are divided.
